body:
This PR closes #60 and addresses several points in #61 

What this PR does:

GPU Compatibility

- KernelAbstractions is removed from the tests
- `runtests_kernel.jl` is removed. GPU tests now are also run with `runtests.jl`. When the `CuArray` arg is supplied, the problems are expanded into `CuArrays` rather than `SArrays`. This prevents the gpu tests on buildkite from also running cpu tests (the scalar tests are still ran).
- Broadcasting already worked if the method was constructed as: `SecantMethod.(x0_cuarray, x1_cuarray)`. This adds support for constructing the method as ` SecantMethod(x0_cuarray, x1_cuarray)`, and adds tests for both.
- Update GPU example in docs

Other:
- Add allocations tests, and change broadcasting behavior to fix failures
- Add codecov token, bump action version
- Add depot path to buildkite pipeline to speed up buildkite initialization
- Add additional slurm memory to buildkite

TODO: 
- update codecov ref (it fails on this PR because it is comparing to main from 3 years ago)
- add to gpu docs if not clear
title: Tr/gpu refactor
